provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Sounds revision Aa to Ff
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say each sound with its picture.
The pupils should be able to circle the first sound in words.
Introduction:
We learned sounds last term. Today we will revise sounds Aa to Ff.
Content:
Say A is for Apple. Show apple picture.
Say B is for Ball. Show ball picture.
Say C is for Cat. Show cat picture.
Say D is for Dog. Show dog picture.
Say E is for Egg. Show egg picture.
Say F is for Fish. Show fish picture.
Class activity:
Give pupils pictures. Ask them to circle the first sound.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does apple start with?
What sound does ball start with?
Circle the first sound in cat.
Summary:
We can say sounds Aa to Ff and find first sounds.

topics.title: Sounds Gg to Ll
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify sounds Gg to Ll.
The pupils should be able to trace each letter correctly.
Introduction:
We learned sounds Aa to Ff. Today we learn sounds Gg to Ll.
Content:
G is for Goat. Show goat picture.
H is for Hat. Show hat picture.
I is for Ink. Show ink picture.
J is for Jug. Show jug picture.
K is for Kite. Show kite picture.
L is for Leaf. Show leaf picture.
Class activity:
Give pupils paper to trace letters Gg to Ll.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does goat start with?
Trace the letter H.
What sound does kite start with?
Summary:
We can say sounds Gg to Ll and trace them.

topics.title: Sounds Mm to Rr
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to match letters to pictures.
The pupils should be able to say sounds Mm to Rr.
Introduction:
We learned sounds up to Ll. Today we learn sounds Mm to Rr.
Content:
M is for Moon. Show moon picture.
N is for Nose. Show nose picture.
O is for Orange. Show orange picture.
P is for Pen. Show pen picture.
Q is for Queen. Show queen picture.
R is for Rope. Show rope picture.
Class activity:
Give pupils letter cards and pictures. Match them.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does moon start with?
Match the letter P to pen.
What sound does rope start with?
Summary:
We can match letters to pictures for sounds Mm to Rr.

topics.title: Sounds Ss to Zz
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say all 26 sounds.
The pupils should be able to identify sounds Ss to Zz.
Introduction:
We learned sounds up to Rr. Today we learn sounds Ss to Zz.
Content:
S is for Sun. Show sun picture.
T is for Tap. Show tap picture.
U is for Umbrella. Show umbrella picture.
V is for Van. Show van picture.
W is for Water. Show water picture.
X is for Box. Show box picture.
Y is for Yellow. Show yellow picture.
Z is for Zoo. Show zoo picture.
Class activity:
Sing the alphabet song together.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does sun start with?
What sound does umbrella start with?
Say all sounds from A to Z.
Summary:
We can say all 26 sounds of the alphabet.

topics.title: Vowel sounds a and e
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify a and e sounds.
The pupils should be able to sort pictures by vowel sounds.
Introduction:
We learned all letter sounds. Today we learn vowel sounds.
Content:
A says a as in cat. Show cat picture.
E says e as in hen. Show hen picture.
A is a vowel. E is a vowel.
Vowels make special sounds.
Class activity:
Give pupils pictures. Sort them into a and e groups.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does cat make?
What sound does hen make?
Which vowel is in bat?
Summary:
We can hear a and e sounds in words.

topics.title: Vowel sounds i, o, u
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify i, o, u sounds.
The pupils should be able to pick middle sounds.
Introduction:
We learned a and e vowels. Today we learn i, o, u vowels.
Content:
I says i as in sit. Show sit picture.
O says o as in pot. Show pot picture.
U says u as in cup. Show cup picture.
I, O, U are vowels too.
Vowels are in the middle of words.
Class activity:
Give pupils word cards. Pick the middle sound.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does sit make?
What sound does pot make?
Pick the middle sound in cup.
Summary:
We can find i, o, u sounds in words.

topics.title: Two letter words
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to blend sounds to read words.
The pupils should be able to read two letter words.
Introduction:
We learned vowel sounds. Today we read two letter words.
Content:
AT says at. Show at picture.
AN says an. Show an picture.
AM says am. Show am picture.
IN says in. Show in picture.
ON says on. Show on picture.
UP says up. Show up picture.
Class activity:
Use letter cards to make words. Read them together.
Evaluation questions:
Blend sounds to read at.
What word is made with a and n?
Read all two letter words.
Summary:
We can blend sounds to read two letter words.

topics.title: Word family an
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read an words.
The pupils should be able to make an words.
Introduction:
We learned two letter words. Today we learn an family.
Content:
AN family words: ban, can, fan, man, pan.
All these words end with an.
We can read them fast.
Class activity:
Make an word ladder on board. Read together.
Evaluation questions:
What word is made with b and an?
Read all an words.
What word is made with p and an?
Summary:
We can read the an word family.

topics.title: Word family at
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read at words.
The pupils should be able to make at words.
Introduction:
We learned an family. Today we learn at family.
Content:
AT family words: bat, cat, fat, hat, mat.
All these words end with at.
We can read them fast.
Class activity:
Use letter cards to make new at words.
Evaluation questions:
What word is made with h and at?
Read all at words.
What word is made with m and at?
Summary:
We can read the at word family.

topics.title: Revision and reading fun
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read two letter words fast.
The pupils should be able to read word wall.
Introduction:
We learned many words. Today we revise and have fun reading.
Content:
Read two letter words: at, an, am, in, on, up.
Read word wall words.
Read with speed and joy.
Class activity:
Play reading game. Say words fast.
Evaluation questions:
Read these words: cat, fan, mat.
Read word wall words.
What family is bat in?
Summary:
We can read many words now.
